documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
35Th Annual General Meeting Of The Company Is Scheduled On Friday, August 28, 2026.

analysis.summary: Stylam Industries reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance and operational highlights, noting a 15% year-on-year increase in revenue for the quarter. The company continues to operate as a zero-debt entity while advancing construction on a new greenfield manufacturing plant in Panchkula, Haryana. Management highlighted capacity utilization of approximately 74% in the laminates division and expressed confidence in achieving its financial guidance amid growing global and domestic demand. Stylam Industries Limited held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 12, 2026, where management discussed the progress of their third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra, expected to commence commercial production between late June and mid-July 2026. Management noted potential revenue contributions of INR 250-300 crores from the new facility in the upcoming fiscal year and targeted peak utilization yielding INR 900-1000 crores.

guidance.claim: Stylam is confident in meeting its financial guidance.
guidance.quote: Stylam is confident in achieving its financial guidance, indicating sustained momentum for growth.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a revenue contribution of INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores from the new plant in the next three quarters.
guidance.quote: But we are quite hopeful that we can get INR300 crores, INR400 crores turnover from this plant in the next 3 quarters.

guidance.claim: The company expects an overall revenue increase of 20% to 25% over the previous year, depending on market conditions.
guidance.quote: We cannot, it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the previous. Again, depends on the situation.

guidance.claim: Management projects that the acrylic segment can achieve between INR 50 crores to INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: I think this year, we would be doing INR50 crores to INR60 crores, INR50 crores to INR70 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The new plant expansion highlights the commitment to meeting increasing market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the company is currently getting delayed with its existing orders.
demand_outlook.quote: And at this moment, we are getting delayed with our existing orders as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes that even with price increases, people will still continue to buy and construct.
demand_outlook.quote: It is not that if the prices go up, people will stop buying it and stop construction.

capex_expansion.claim: Stylam is setting up a new plant for laminate manufacturing adjacent to its existing facility in Manak Tabra.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam is setting up a new state-of-the-art plant for the manufacturing of laminates, just adjoining to its existing plant in Manak Tabra, Panchkula, Haryana.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is strengthening its leadership by commissioning a new greenfield manufacturing facility as its third laminate plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam Industries is strengthening its leadership position with commissioning of new green-field manufacturing facility, our third laminate plant, strategically located next to our existing facility at Manak Tabra in Panchkula, Haryana

capex_expansion.claim: Groundwork for the new plant is currently underway.
capex_expansion.quote: The groundwork for the new plant is underway, enhancing our ability to meet rising global demand with greater speed and scale.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production at the third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra is expected to start between the end of June and the middle of July.
capex_expansion.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

capex_expansion.claim: Testing of machines for the new plant will start by the end of the month.
capex_expansion.quote: Now it is almost near to final stage and testing of machine is already there, testing of machine is -- we will start by the end of this month even, even 2, 3 weeks.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex incurred so far for the new plant is INR 334 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have at this moment done the capex of INR334 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The share of value-added products was enhanced, expanding the product range and improving net gross margins.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the gross margin was 49% in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: I think it was 49% in the fourth quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The company has already implemented price increases of 3% to 5% with customers.
margins_costs.quote: We already increased 3% to 5% to our customers, almost every manufacturer.

margins_costs.claim: Fixed costs for the expansion have already been incurred, so profitability will begin from day one of production.
margins_costs.quote: See, profitable level is still from the day 1. We have no, we have an investment, we are not paying any instalment, we are not paying any interest. So profitability from the day 1, when we start on next month end, then we will produce 1 container that will be profitable.

orders_capacity.claim: The laminates division reached approximately 74% capacity utilization following modular expansions.
orders_capacity.quote: The company reached approximately 74% capacity utilization in the laminates division following modular expansions at existing facilities, increasing overall capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates an annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets.
orders_capacity.quote: Annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam sold 3.17 million sheets during Q1 FY27 compared to 3.27 million sheets in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Company has sold 3.17 Mn Sheets during the Q1 FY27 (Domestic - 1.10 Mn & Export 2.07 Mn) as compared to 3.27 Mn Sheets in Q4 FY26 (Domestic - 1.06 Mn & Export 2.21 Mn).

orders_capacity.claim: The hot coating technology production capacity is 1 million laminates per year.
orders_capacity.quote: World’s latest Hot Coating technology with production capacity of 1 million laminates per year.

orders_capacity.claim: The 100% Acrylic Solid Surface production capacity stands at 300,000 panels per year.
orders_capacity.quote: 100% Acrylic Solid Surface production capacity of 300,000 panels per year.

orders_capacity.claim: The laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: the laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam reached and maintained the status of a completely net debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: Became a net debt-free company and maintained this status, even after establishing a new plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The delay in the plant commissioning was caused by Supreme Court observations and the need to obtain environmental clearance from the Ministry of Environment in Delhi.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, in last year, maybe October, November, there was some Supreme Court observation in this area -- clarification, we need to have to meet EC, environment clearance. So then we applied that environment clearance to MOF, Ministry of Environment Delhi, as there is no CER available in Haryana at that time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commodity raw material prices have increased due to supplies coming from the Middle East market.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, the things, the raw material commodity prices have increased for each and every company, not only laminates, we talk about any company, any product due to this, all the supply are coming from Middle East market.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production of the new plant will commence at the latest by the middle of July and at the earliest by the end of June.
management_commitments.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant within the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And that is why what we were saying that the ramp-ups definitely in the next 2 years, we will be able to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant.

management_commitments.claim: Aica and the company will sit down to discuss cooperation once legalities and the open offer are finished by mid-June.
management_commitments.quote: Once it is done by mid-June, then we would be sitting down and see how we can help each other.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
